articleTitle: Safety Management System for Factory Workers using UWB Indoor Positioning and Wearable Vibrotactile Guidance: Morocco Case Study
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper proposes a safety monitoring system for workers in factory environments, based on tracking their position relative to danger zones and alerting them of potential hazards. The system uses Ultra-Wideband (UWB) positioning and vibrating vests to provide tactile proximity warnings to workers. A case study is presented for an automobile manufacturing site in Morocco, where the proposed system is simulated and analyzed for its efficiency. The results indicate a median localization error of less than 12 cm under static conditions and less than 28 cm under dynamic conditions. Additionally, design considerations and a draft cost analysis for the proposed system are discussed. Hence, the system has the potential to enhance the safety and productivity of the industrial workforce, by potentially reducing the workplace injuries and fatalities.

articleTitle: Vibration Characteristics Analysis of Transformer Core Faults Based on Multy-Physical Field Coupling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In order to study the vibration characteristics of transformer core fault on the environment of the offshore atmosphere, a three-dimensional transient model is established by taking SC9-100/10 dry-type transformer as the object and using COMSOL. Conduct electric-magnetic-solid multi-physical field coupling. The influence of core loosening and multi-point grounding on the vibration of transformer core is explored. The results show that: 1) The vibration intensity of the transformer is negatively correlated with the compaction of the iron core. Vibration signal fundamental frequency amplitude increases The amplitude of the fundamental frequency of the vibration signal, that is, the frequency component of 100 Hz increases, and the content of higher harmonics (greater than 100 Hz) increases. 2) When a multi-point ground fault occurs, The acceleration amplitude of transformer core decreases. The simulation of transformer core faults by COMSOL is reasonable and accurate. The vibration characteristics of transformer core are related to its state. Different types of transformer core faults can be differentiated by analyzing vibration characteristics. The calculation methods used in the process of transformer core vibration characteristics and the relevant conclusions obtained from simulation have further guiding significance for predicting transformer core vibration and improving transformer core structure design.

articleTitle: Research on Underwater Robust Object Detection Method Based on Improved YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Due to the complex underwater environment, underwater biological occlusion and small objects are more common, resulting in lower accuracy and poor robustness of object detection algorithms, so an underwater robust object detection method based on improved YOLOv5s is proposed in this paper. First, GridMask data enhancement method is used to solve the problem of insufficient detection accuracy of YOLOv5s when obstacles block the target. Second, the NMS (Non-Maximum Suppression) in YOLOv5s is changed to the DIoU NMS algorithm for improving the detection accuracy of the overlapped objects. Finally, the structure of PAN+FPN in YOLOv5s is improved to RepGFPN to optimize the ability of the original algorithm to detect small objects. Compared with other object detection algorithms, the results show that the proposed method improves the robustness of underwater object detection.

articleTitle: Design of a Novel Force Controlled Polishing Device Based on a Coupled Active-Passive Compliant Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Aiming at the demand for a low-cost and precision robotic polishing force control device, this paper proposes a new polishing device driven by a coupled active-passive compliant mechanism, whose active compliant mechanism is composed of a cylinder, while the passive compliant mechanism is formed by three springs. The active-passive compliant mechanism is designed between a cylindrical dynamic/static platform, and the stiffness of this device is analyzed by the finite element method. Based on this, the static model of this device was analyzed, the relationship model between the cylinder air pressure and the output force of the device was obtained, and a real-time polishing force obtaining model based on a one-dimensional force sensor was proposed. Finally, the principle prototype of this device was developed to establish a polishing test platform, and a series of contact force-obtaining comparison experiments were conducted with a 6-D force sensor under different postures, and good experiment results were obtained to verify the accuracy of the proposed polishing force obtaining model and the practicality of the active-passive compliant coupling polishing device.

articleTitle: A Cooperative Localization Method for Multiple Unmanned Underwater Vehicles Based on Improved Factor Graph
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper investigates a cooperative localization problem of multiple unmanned underwater vehicles (UUVs) subject to non-Gaussian heavy-tailed measurement noise. In order to reduce noise effects, a maximum entropy factor graph (MEFG) algorithm is proposed by combining factor graph theory and maximum correlation entropy theory. To verify the effectiveness and advantages of the proposed algorithm, comparisons are made with traditional localization algorithms. The results show that the localization error of the proposed MEFG algorithm is significantly smaller than other algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Key Problems of Synchronous Control of Hydraulic System Based on Particle Swarm Fuzzy PID
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: For more effective synchronization of actuatoes, the hydraulic system is modeled and adjust the hydraulic system through the fuzzy PID controller optimized by particle swarm optimization, and the hydraulic system is modeled in AMESim and simulated in Simulink., the AMESim-Simulink joint simulation platform is used to simulate and analyze the synchronous control of the hydraulic system. The simulation shows that the fuzzy PID with particle swarm optimization is more accurate for hydraulic system synchronization control, and the addition the hydraulic system has faster response time and the system is more resistant to interference.

articleTitle: Research on video-based moving object tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Video based motion object tracking is an important research topic in the field of computer vision. This paper studies the development of video tracking technology, compares and analyzes object tracking algorithms based on contrast analysis, motion detection, and matching, and summarizes the characteristics of each algorithm. In addition, through comprehensive research and analysis, this paper has designed and implemented vehicle video tracking based on SIFT (Scale-invariant Feature Transform) in dynamic backgrounds. This practical application environment is relatively complex, with dual motion of background and target, and there are also many noise points, lighting changes, and occlusions in the environment, effectively solving the problem of moving target tracking in dynamic and complex backgrounds.

articleTitle: Research On Force Feedback Controller Of Interventional Robot Based On Pneumatic Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the operation mode of the master controller does not comply with the traditional surgical habits, the traditional surgical experience cannot be applied, and some of the master controllers cannot provide both axial and circumaxial tactile feedback information during operation, a two-degree of freedom interventional robot master controller with the function of force feedback and the use of traditional surgical experience is designed. Its structure is compact and easy to carry. The master controller collects the motion information of the doctor’s hand through displacement sensor and encoder, and realizes tactile feedback reproduction in axial and circumferential directions through pneumatic drive and motor drive. In addition, a primary force feedback control system was built. The displacement detection and force feedback performance of the primary controller were evaluated through experiments. The experiment results indicate that the master controller designed in this paper can achieve motion control of the catheter and provide tactile feedback information according to the resistance of the catheter.

articleTitle: A CMOS Concentration of Tea Polyphenols to Frequency Converter for Applications of Sensing the Concentration of Tea Polyphenols
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A CMOS concentration of tea polyphenols converter is newly used for sensing the concentration of the polyphenols applications. The proposed converter can transform the concentration of tea polyphenols into frequency linearly. Through the frequency, the concentration of the tea polyphenols could be swiftly and easily attained. Besides, the design of a multistage relaxation oscillator is innovatively investigated in order to provide higher sensitivity for measurements of tea polyphenols. The input range of the proposed converter was 0.1 to 2.2 V, the corresponding range of output frequency was 3.37 to 20.9 MHz. The sensitivities of the proposed converter was 8.34 MHz/V. The proposed chip could be used for sensing the concentration of tea polyphenols applications.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control with Block Matrix for Unmanned Surface Vehicles Trajectory Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In order to work out the matter of long calculation time and poor real-time performance of trajectory tracking controller designed by Model Predictive Control (MPC), a model predictive control trajectory tracking based on variable step size in control horizon is proposed by means of move blocking. Firstly, changing of control horizon step size through move blocking. Then, integrating it into the solution process of quadratic programming and reconstructing objective function form. So as to cut the amount of variables to be solved in the solution process and reduce the solution calculation time. Finally, the comparison experiments of MPC with move blocking for trajectory tracking control of Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) and MPC without move blocking for trajectory tracking control of USV are designed. The results show that compared with MPC without move blocking, the average calculation time is reduced by 15.79%.

articleTitle: Heave measurement algorithm for strapdown inertial Navigation system based on adaptive multiple low-pass filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The traditional heave measurement algorithm based on inertia technology and digital high pass filter leads to the heave measurement error due to the phase advance of the output signal. The article analyzes the function and error characteristics of the digital high-pass filter. A strapdown inertial navigation heave measurement algorithm based on adaptive multiple low-pass filter (AMLF) is proposed to solve the phase lead error introduced by the characteristics of digital high-pass filter. First, the accelerometer in the strapdown inertial navigation measures the wave motion information and identifies the dominant frequency of the wave motion. Then introduce a low-pass filter with parameters that can be adjusted in real time with the dominant frequency of the ocean wave to filter out the low-frequency error signal in the accelerometer measurement information. Finally, the real heave information can be obtained by subtracting the filtered error signal from the original signal measured by the accelerometer. The algorithm solves the problem that the digital high-pass filter leads the phase of the heave measurement signal. The simulation results show that the heave measurement accuracy of the proposed algorithm is within 5cm, which improves the real-time performance and accuracy of heave measurement.

articleTitle: Attention-based Insulator Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the electric system, the demand for auto-inspection of the electric transmission system, e.g., transmission lines, and insulators, is increasing. To achieve automatic insulator inspection, we propose a two-stage insulator defect inspection framework which consists of the attention-based insulator detection network and the defect inspection network. The attention-based insulator detection network is responsible for the positioning of the insulator and the defect inspection model determines whether the insulator is corrupted. The two-stage detect-then-inspect design avoids the influence of background and enables high-precision inspection. Experimental results on our collected dataset show that our model outperforms previous object detection method.

articleTitle: Study on the Creative Design of Tourism Products in Industrial Culture
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This study takes into account the emphasis on cultural industries in China’s national policy and the government’s plans for related industries in industrial cities after the “New Crown Epidemic”, and proposes strategies for developing cultural and creative product designs that suit the characteristics of industrial tourism in the region. This study takes Jilin Province, China, as a case study, and proposes a series of targeted design strategies, such as the differentiation of pre-design thinking, adhering to the principle of giving full play to the local industrial cultural characteristics, digging deeper into the value of cultural tourism resources, and incorporating the unique industrial cultural genes of the region, forming specific measures to solve the problem of cultural and creative product design, and enriching the theoretical research and practical application of “industrial tourism Theoretical research and practical application of “industrial tourism culture”, the development and design of cultural and creative products as an entry point to promote the effective adjustment of modern industrial structure and the development of regional economy.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Small and Agile Aquatic-Aerial Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: With the increasing demand for the exploration of marine resources and the observation of marine issues, many aquatic-aerial vehicles were developed. This paper developed a small agile water aquatic-aerial vehicle that can fly in the air and swim in water. A foldable mechanism was proposed to reduce excessive underwater resistance caused by its specified flight structure, and a bi-stable structure was proposed to maintain the stability of the foldable mechanism and reduce the consumption of the servo. The mechanical modeling of the foldable mechanism is established. And the servo with the torque of 45kg$\cdot$cm is able to open the foldable mechanism 0.4s to complete the mode conversion of cross medium when the aircraft jumps out of the water. CFD simulation was also carried out in water. Driven by thruster with 38N propulsion, the vehicle reaches a speed of 5.1m/s. Finally, the vehicle prototype was assembled. In the future, we will focus on underwater motion and aerial flight experiments, and ultimately achieve cross medium flight.

Author Keywords: Four Arm Foldable Mechanism Cross-Medium Robot

articleTitle: Integrated Navigation of SINS DVL SSS Based on FGO
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Side-scan sonar (SSS) can provide a top-down view image of the seafloor. Combining with strap-down inertial navigation system (SINS) and Doppler velocity log (DVL) navigation system, a map of the seafloor can be created. However, over time, the position error from these navigation systems may grow. To address this issue, this study proposes a method that combines the SSS image information in order to reduce these errors.Current algorithms use a feature-based method to register SSS images and calculate relative position. However, this method is susceptible to disturbance from acoustic noise and viewing direction. Furthermore, while most terrain-aided navigation algorithms can suppress position error drift, they cannot correct heading errors, limiting their ability to improve accuracy.In our paper, we propose an improved method that uses Fourier-based registration technique for SSS images. Instead of determining image translation from features, this algorithm uses phase correlation to achieve more stable and accurate relative position output. Additionally, we use factor graph optimization (FGO) to integrate information from both SSS images and SINS/DVL systems. This not only reduces position estimation errors but also improves heading accuracy.Tests on physical sonar images have verified that the proposed Fourier-based method enhances stability. Moreover, field tests have shown that using the integrated navigation method has improved positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: A Leader-Follower Trajectory Planning Approach for Cooperative Robotic System in Automated Fiber Placement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The trajectory planning of cooperative robotic system for automated fiber placement (AFP) is a crucial topic since it has significant influence on the quality of the final products. This paper proposes a novel leader-follower trajectory planning approach for a 13-DOF (degree of freedom) cooperative robotic system in AFP. A 6-DOF serial robot holding the fiber placement head works as the leader, a 6-RSS (Revolute-Spherical-Spherical) parallel robot with a 1-DOF rotary stage holding the Y-shape mandrel works as the follower. Given a predefined fiber path with the desired angle 0°, an optimal trajectory planning method is developed for the serial robot subject to the kinematic and dynamic constraints. A cost function is established to guarantee the smoothness of the planned trajectory. Under this circumstance, the path of the fiber placement head may be deviated from the desired fiber path. According to the geometric constraint of AFP, namely, the direction of the roller in the fiber placement head should keep perpendicular to the mandrel surface, a vision-based trajectory generation strategy is designed for the parallel robot. Based on the desired trajectory of a defined point on the mandrel, the desired end-effector trajectory of the parallel robot can be determined using the visual measurement results. It can compensate the motion of the serial robot and ensure that the fiber is placed along the desired path. Simulation has been conducted to demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed leader-follower trajectory planning approach.

articleTitle: An Approach of Assembly Deviation Analysis based on Jacobian Model and Skin Model Shapes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Form defects are an inevitable phenomenon in the process of part processing, which has great influence on the quality and performance of products. In initial design stage of products, generating tolerance representation model conforming to tolerance specification considering form defects is a key part to analyze and predict the assembly accuracy of product, and the skin model shapes (SMS) are proved to be valid in response to these needs. However, the spatial distribution characteristics of form defects (SDCFD) have not been concerned in existing research works when generating SMS, which may influence the assembly deviation analysis. In addition, the recent research on the calculation method of assembly deviation propagation and accumulation mainly focuses on the method of homogeneous transformation matrix, which has lower computational efficiency and complex operation. To solve the above problems, this paper presents an assembly deviation analysis method considering SDCFD based on Jacobian model and SMS, which contains two advantages of efficient deviation propagation and effective representation of tolerance. Firstly, the SMS is generated based on Non-Gaussian random field (NGRF) considering SDCFD; secondly, the positioning deviation between two mating surfaces (PDTMS) for serial connection and partial parallel connection are calculated with progressive contact method and constraint registration method, respectively; thirdly, the Jacobian model is applied to calculate the cumulative deviation of mechanical assembly according to function requirement. Finally, a case study is given to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: A CMOS Sulfur Dioxide Concentration to Time Period Converter for Measuring Sulfur Dioxide Concentration in Food Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A CMOS sulfur dioxide concentration to time period converter is newly proposed for measuring sulfur dioxide concentration in food applications. The proposed converter can transform sulfur dioxide concentration in solution into time period linearly. Through the time period, sulfur dioxide concentration in solution could be easily and quickly obtained. In order to be suitably used in different kinds of sulfur dioxide concentrations in solution, a converter with the range of low resistance was designed, which was 100 $\Omega$ to 100 k$\Omega$. The inputted range of sulfur dioxide concentration in solution was 200 to 1600 ppm, the corresponding outputted range of the proposed converter with sulfur dioxide sensor was 471.65 $\mu \mathrm{s}$ to 1.166 ms. The proposed chip could be used for sensing sulfur dioxide concentration in food applications.

articleTitle: Research on Electromagnetic Compatibility in the Design of Battery Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In this paper, on the basis of the electric car battery, battery SOC estimation and equalization management. First of all, to understand of battery management system function structure, according to the functional requirement for modular design. Using the extended Kalman filtering algorithm for SOC estimation, which is based on passive equalization process sequence algorithm play a balanced role. analyzed different forms of filtering circuits and verified effectiveness through simulation.

articleTitle: Design of a Desktop Upper Limb Rehabilitation Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In this paper, a six-degree-of-freedom desktop mobile rehabilitation robot for upper limb of stroke patients and a desktop interaction system in passive rehabilitation mode are designed to address the disadvantages of the current mechanical structure of the upper limb rehabilitation robot and its inconvenient use. The selection of the drive system and the structural design of each joint were completed to reduce the cost of the robot while ensuring the performance requirements. The kinematic mathematical model of the robot was established according to the D-H method. The motion of the robot was analyzed by the prototype experiment, which verified the correctness of the kinematic algorithm and met the expected design goals, and provided a reliable basis for the study of robot trajectory planning and control. The desktop interactive system in passive rehabilitation mode designed in this paper intensifies the training of each joint of the patient’s upper limb through good position control of the robot, which is conducive to increasing the enthusiasm of the patient’s participation in training and improving the rehabilitation training effect.

articleTitle: Research on the Air Gap Magnetic Field of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor for High-speed Compressor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The high-speed air compressor, which is applied for the hydrogen fuel cell (HFC), is one of the important modules. The air compressor provides the high-pressure air for the chemical reaction between hydrogen and oxygen. The high-speed permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is used to drive the high-speed air compressor. The air gap magnetic field determines the electromechanical conversion ability of the motor. In this paper, the numerical and experimental analysis of the air gap electromagnetic field between the stator and rotor was carried out. The analytic model of the magnetic flux density in the air gap was built. The analytic expressions of the magnetic flux density were theoretically derived. The analytical solution included the magnetic flux density of the cylinder permanent magnet, armature and motor load. The finite element method was used to calculate the magnetic flux density of the air gap. The comparison results between the analytic method and the finite element method showed that the fundamental wave of the analytical solution was consistent with the simulation results without considering the influence of tooth slots. The experiment of the magnetization rotor was carried out. The error of the magnetic flux density value between the experimental results and the theoretical values is about 3%. The experimental value of the magnetic flux density is slightly smaller than the theoretical value.

articleTitle: A DDPG-Based Method of Autonomous Catheter Navigation in Virtual Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Vascular interventional surgery is the main method for treating cardiovascular diseases. But navigating endovascular catheters through the vascular tree is a highly challenging task even for highly trained specialists. Automation of this task can reduce the burden on surgeons and is expected to improve the surgical outcomes. Although there have been relevant studies utilizing reinforcement learning algorithms to realize autonomous navigation of catheter in the virtual environment Cathsim. However, the kinematics model of the catheter in Cathsim does not conform to the operating mode of the catheter in real vascular interventional surgery. Besides, there are problems such as low success rates of catheter autonomous navigation tasks. To address these issues, this paper modifies the kinematics model of the catheter in Cathsim and designs a catheter autonomous navigation model based on reinforcement learning DDPG (Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient) algorithm. The experimental results show that the agents trained through DDPG in this paper performs better than the agents trained through PPO (Proximal Policy optimization) in other studies in terms of navigation task success rate, completion time, and contact force between the catheter and vascular wall during the navigation process.

articleTitle: Underactuated Autonomous Underwater Vehicle Trajectory Tracking Control in Three Dimensions Based on Fractional Order Sliding Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper proposes a Finite-Time Fractional-Order Sliding Mode Controller (FTFOSMC) for the three-dimensional trajectory tracking of an underactuated Autonomous Underwater Vehicle (AUV) using only three available control inputs - the rudder, diving plane, and rotating propeller. The controller uses a Finite-Time Integral Sliding Mode Control in the first step to quickly and accurately reduce tracking errors. In the second step, fractional calculus is introduced to enhance the control system’s robustness. The stability of the control system is proven by Lyapunov stability analysis, and the convergence time’s upper bound is calculated. Simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Optimization of a Piezoelectric Bending Beam-based Human Knee Energy Harvester
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The concept of extracting energy from the human body to recharge depleted energy sources has gained significant attention. Recently, scientists have focused on harnessing biomechanical energy from the human body while walking. The aim of this study is to optimize a piezoelectric bending beam-based human knee energy harvester to enhance performance. Specifically, the shape of the bending beam (the substrate: a carbon fiber plate) is optimized to modulate the deformation, such that the average strain of the piezoelectric macro fiber composites (MFC) attached to the bending beam is improved to generate more electricity. In addition, the effects of the substrate’s thickness and the hinge base’s height for the bending beam on the output power are also analyzed. Experimental testing on a subject is conducted to validate our design and test the performance. The harvester generates an average power output of 24.55 mW when walking at 4 km/h on a treadmill. The harvester’s total weight is 278g.

articleTitle: Force Feedback Bilateral Control of Multi-DOF Cooperative Manipulator: Design and Realization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In this paper, a bilateral teleoperation system for a multi-DOF Cooperative Manipulator with large gear-ratio joints is proposed for. Firstly, low-impedance dragging of the master robot is achieved through admittance control, then, the difference between the operating force of the master robot and the contact force of the slave robot is used as input for the admittance model to provide force feedback, and the perception accuracy of 6-DOF F/T sensor is improved through gravity compensation. Finally, considering the delay of bilateral teleoperation, the interaction stability between the robot and the environment is analyzed.

articleTitle: New Pulse High-frequency Signal Injection without Position Sensor Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traditional pulse high-frequency voltage injection method is easy to cause the instability of the position estimation system, a new Q-axis high-frequency current response phase modulation signal method is constructed by locking the Q-axis by using phase-locked loop technology. A new position estimation compensation strategy and a rotor position estimation strategy based on the pulsating high-frequency current injection method for permanent magnet synchronous motors are proposed to effectively avoid the backpotential caused by the increase in speed and the increase in position estimation error caused by the cross-coupling term as well as the instability of the estimation system; the feasibility and effectiveness of the method are demonstrated through experiments.

articleTitle: Stabilization of T-S Fuzzy Nonlinear Systems by Intermittent Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: As an extremely significant class of system, the stability analysis problem of nonlinear systems has always been a research hotspot. This paper studies the intermittent control problem of nonlinear systems, and represents the system as a Takagi Sugeno (T-S) fuzzy model system. In order to stabilize the nonlinear systems, the intermittent control with variable switching rate control strategy is put out. In the proposed method, the sequence of switching rate is both variable and monotonically diminishing. In addition, this method can also be used to estimate the range of control gain K. Finally, numerical simulation outcomes validate the method’s viability and efficiency.

articleTitle: Study on a Two-layer Path Planning Method of Spherical Multi-robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A path planning method based on a two-layer coordination system is proposed for the compatibility requirement of path planning global optimum and local coordination in a spherical multi-robot system. In the first layer of the algorithm, the global path quality is improved by proposing a nonlinear sine factor and a sparrow search algorithm with improved levy flight strategy to plan the global collision-free optimal path for each robot. In the second layer, a rolling window method is used to determine the possible collision positions of each robot in the system, and a priority-based conflict resolution strategy is proposed to complete the local coordination of the path near the corresponding position. The experimental results show that the path planning method enables the robots to drive along the global optimal path, but still can carry out flexible and orderly local path coordination, which effectively improves the path planning performance of the system.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based System for Real-Time Face Tracking and Expression Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Facial expressions play a crucial role in human communication by conveying emotions and messages without using words. They are a vital form of non-verbal communication that complements verbal communication. With the advent of artificial intelligence and machine learning, there has been an increase in the number of datasets and algorithms related to facial expressions. It has become an essential topic to explore automatic face tracking, expression recognition, and personalized feedback for different expressions. In this paper, we propose a real-time system that can track faces, recognize expressions, and provide distinct feedback based on the detected expressions. We present experimental results to demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of our proposed system.

articleTitle: An SMA Wire-based Tendon Actuator and its Application on Robotic Fingers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Towards a wider application of Shape memory alloy (SMA) driven actuators, by following the principle of easy assembly and applicable design, a novel design of tendon-driven actuators for robotic and wearable devices is presented. The actuator is driven by a group of SMA wires which is enhanced by wrapping layers of Teflon and copper for better insulation and heat dissipation while retaining the characteristic of easy manufacturing. As a demonstration, a multiple SMA wire-driven tendon robotic finger, which utilizes the actuator on agonist-antagonist muscle pairs without any bias strings, is presented. The demonstrating device is built by a combined group of LEGO Technic bricks and custom 3D-printed blocks. A real-time control and sensor circuit system is designed based on IIC bus sensors, including a 6-DoF inertial meter and an ADC for a rotational encoder, for evaluating the demonstrating device. The result of the experiment shows that our design exhibits a superior performance, on both fast-actuating speed and relaxing speed, when compared to conventional SMA wire-based robot fingers.

articleTitle: Design of a Novel Modular Serial Pipeline Inspection Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper presents a novel system design for a modular serial pipeline inspection robot, named RoboChain-I, which has the capability of actively deforming to adapt to changes in pipeline shape and diameter. RoboChain-I is specifically designed for inspecting small and medium-sized pipelines with inner diameters ranging from 17.5 cm to 44 cm, and exhibits high environmental adaptability. In contrast to conventional wheeled pipeline climbing robots, RoboChain-I offers a more flexible joint degrees of freedom setting, enabling it to navigate complex pipelines. The effectiveness of the new structure and control method of the pipeline inspection robot proposed was validated through experiments conducted on the ground and within straight and inclined pipelines. The results demonstrate that RoboChain-I has superior pipeline mobility performance.

articleTitle: An Efficient RRT*-based Path Planning for Mobile Robot with Fast Convergence Rate
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In recent decades, sampling-based path planning methods have garnered increasing attention from researchers due to their excellent performance, particularly in nonlinear complex environments and high-dimensional spaces. As a classical sampling-based algorithm, RRT*, claims to achieve an optimal solution, but it has a slow convergence rate or takes an infinite amount of time to do so. To address this limitation, this study proposes a novel algorithm called D-RRT*. D-RRT* employs the concept of dynamic region sampling to enhance the efficiency of path generation by leveraging the tree environment as heuristic information. In contrast to the conventional uniform sampling approach, dynamic region sampling strategy increases the density of sampled points in the forward region near the target point, which significantly improves the search efficiency for feasible paths. Secondly, once the initial path is found, the algorithm extracts the directly accessible nodes of the path as key nodes. The key nodes are positioned to facilitate the discovery of the optimal path. By optimizing these key nodes, not only does the algorithm improve memory utilization, but it also reduces the number of iterations required to converge towards the optimal solution. Finally, the state-of-the art RRT-based algorithm, such as RRT*, Q-RRT* and F-RRT*, are used for comparison in two representative maps including real environments. Statistical analyses are conducted to demonstrate the robustness of the proposed algorithm. Simulation results indicated that the proposed algorithm yields better solutions for solving path planning problems in terms of algorithm convergence speed and path length.

articleTitle: IoT Healthcare System based on ESP32 for Smart Home
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Seniors living alone face various health and safety risks, which can often require prompt emergency assistance. Thankfully, advancements in technology have enabled several assistive devices to help monitor and support seniors living independently. In the paper a healthcare system based on IoT, mainly Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), specifically, ESP32 for smart nursing home is presented. The core of the system is a BLE gateway, which services three components, smart pillow for body temperature and presence, wrist-worn watch to detect fall, and a pulse oximeter to measure heart rate and SpO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, which then transmits the encrypted data to MQTT Broker, based on the protocol, all the authorized subscriber can get notice of anomaly in real-time. Experiments show that the system is able to accurately and promptly notify the results. Such a low-costs and simple-architecture system can be deployed in nursing home or house of senior easily and provide quick response.

articleTitle: UAV Path Planning Method based on Quantum Squirrel Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: To solve the path planning problem of UAV in complex terrain environments to avoid various threats and constraints. The Quantum Squirrel Search Algorithm (QSSA) is proposed to solve the premature convergence and search stagnation phenomena of Squirrel Search Algorithms (SSA) in three-dimensional path planning. Firstly, a three-dimensional trajectory planning model for unmanned aerial vehicles is established based on their objective functions and constraints. Secondly, aiming at the premature phenomenon of squirrel foraging algorithms in dealing with high-dimensional band constraints, this paper designs quantum rotation gates and quantum rotation angles to improve the mining ability of the algorithm. Finally, the quantum squirrel foraging algorithm is applied to the path planning problem. The experimental results show that QSSA outperforms Whale optimization algorithm (WOA), Grey Wolf optimization (GWO) and Squirrel Search Algorithm (SSA) in terms of its optimization performance. It can quickly obtain a safe and feasible path compared to other algorithms.

articleTitle: YOLOv7-Based Land and Underwater Target Detection and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: There is a growing demand for marine resource development. Bionic amphibious robots can replace humans to conduct land and underwater exploration, which has important research significance. Deep learning has developed rapidly in recent years, and many kinds of target detection algorithms have emerged. We select one two-stage target detection algorithm Faster R-CNN, three single-stage target detection algorithms SSD, Centernet, and YOLOv7. We use each of these four algorithms to train the VOC2007 dataset in a deep learning environment. After the training is completed, these four models are evaluated and predicted separately. We find an algorithm that is most suitable for the amphibious robot applicationYOLOv7. Finally, we use the YOLOv7 model to detect the underwater dataset, and the results prove that the model is promising for detecting small underwater targets.

articleTitle: Adaptive Motion Control of Non-affine Unmanned Hovercraft Under Asymmetries Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Addressing the issue of non-affine motion control for unmanned hovercraft operating at high speeds while taking safety into account. A novel algorithm based on asymmetrical integral barrier Lyapunov function (IBLF) and neural network is proposed. Firstly, the non-affine model of the surge speed and yaw subsystem of the unmanned hovercraft is analyzed. By utilizing neural networks, the implicit function theorem is used to demonstrate that there is a single solution to the estimate of ambiguous parameters of control inputs. Additionally, to ensure that yaw angular velocity maintains a pre-specified safety threshold at high speed and that the surge speed performance necessary, a time IBLF is introducing to designed the surge speed and yaw controller. Furthermore, all tracking errors are ultimately uniformly bounded, according to the Lyapunov stability theory. Finally, simulation results confirm the suggested controller’s effectiveness and robustness.

articleTitle: Fast Terminal Sliding Mode Control for Accuracy Motion Tracking of Electro-Hydraulic Servo System Based on Online Trajectory Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In order to achieve fast transient response and high-accuracy motion tracking of the electro-hydraulic servo systems (EHSS), this paper presents a control strategy with internal and external double closed-loop has been developed in this paper. First of all, an online trajectory re-planning algorithm based on a second-order discrete nonlinear integrator is designed to make the re-planned trajectory to tracking the reference trajectory in the shortest time under the system flow rate and pressure constraints. Additionally, a nonlinear position tracking controller based on the fast terminal sliding mode is developed to ensure high steady-state tracking accuracy. Finally, the experimental results demonstrate that the proposed control structure can not only ensure good steady-state position tracking accuracy, but also achieve fast transient response without violating the flow rate and supply oil pressure constraints.

articleTitle: A detailed stochastic model based on the elevation angle of BDS-3 satellite
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In BDS satellite navigation and positioning, a reasonable random model of observation information is an important foundation for achieving high-precision positioning. This article is based on the limitation of using empirical values in traditional height angle random models. The least squares variance component estimation method is used to fit the parameters of the height angle random model in real time. The simplified Helmert variance component estimation method is used to estimate the accuracy of BDS-3 satellite observation information. Finally, the positioning accuracy of the improved height angle random model is compared in the high-precision relative positioning algorithm. The experimental results show that the improved height angle random model has a certain improvement in positioning accuracy compared to traditional height angle models, with improvements of 20.2%, 34.2%, and 14.7% in E, N, and U directions, respectively.

articleTitle: Development of A Smart Interfacing Dashboard Between Management and Shop-Floor for Industry 3.0 Machines and Small and Medium Enterprises (SME)
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The aim of the present work is to incorporate industry 4.0 features in industry 3.0 machines like CNC machines. One of the key elements of industry 4.0 is dashboards, which helps to visualize the status of the system at a glance. In general, dashboards were created for management and shop floors individually. In this work, smart dashboards are created for microSMEs with CNC machines to get a glance of the processes happening in the shop floor, the scheduled production plan associated with it, the idle time of the machines etc using the Industrial Internet of things and sensors. The present work also proposes a dashboard for interfacing between shop floor and management which will help in getting the real time status of the production like pauses during production, operator unavailability, communication to the available operators. The proposed dashboard is implemented over an Intelitek Promill 8000 CNC milling machine on a shop floor to bridge communication between shop floor authority and the operator.

articleTitle: Study on Intelligent Manufacturing System of Discrete Machining Shop
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: To better promote the application of intelligent manufacturing in machining process of discrete manufacturing and improve the manufacturing efficiency, an intelligent manufacturing architecture for aerospace machining workshop was proposed. Furthermore, the operation mechanism was also described. Complementary to the architecture and the mechanism, relationships among subsystems, between system and external environment were discussed, and the fundamental principles and methods of operation, evolution, optimization, management and control were revealed by studying the management and control mode of the workshop based on data driven. Ultimately, the intelligent manufacture system of workshop level for aerospace machining was formed. It has some reference value for the intelligent manufacturing of discrete manufacturing field.

articleTitle: A Research of Voxel-Based Amygdala Genetic Network Based on Improved Label Propagation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Currently, the amygdala is often treated as a single entity in research, which may overlook valuable information from each amygdala subregion. There have been few studies examining the amygdala at the voxel level. In this paper, we propose an amygdala voxel-based genetic correlation network to explore the relationship between the amygdala subregions and Alzheimer's disease (AD). We conducted GWAS analysis using data from the ADNI Database and combined Single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) results highly correlated with AD with amygdala voxel-based imaging data to construct a genetic correlation network for the left and right amygdala. We used an improved label propagation algorithm to conduct a more thorough analysis of the network and explore the potential relationship between AD and the amygdala subregions at the voxel level. We verified the pathways found by this method using KEGG and GO analysis and found that they have a significant impact on the pathogenesis of AD.

articleTitle: Design of An Automated Injection System Based on Dorsal Hand Vessel Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Dorsal hand venipuncture is one of the most common tools used in clinical care, but there are fewer studies addressing the identification of dorsal hand veins. In real life, venipuncture often fails due to various reasons such as skin color or obesity. Therefore, it is of great practical importance to design a system with clear NIR vascular visualization and automatic injection. This thesis describes a system for identifying and localizing the veins on the back of the hand for detection. The global dorsal hand vein images were acquired using the MT9V034 CMOS camera under S50 nm NIR light irradiation. Based on this, a threshold value is acquired by the Otsu method to remove the background part outside the back of the hand, and then the vascular image is enhanced by a data enhancement algorithm to obtain a clear vascular image. Then, the blood vessels are segmented using segmentation algorithm to achieve precise positioning of blood vessels, and finally, automatic injection is performed by robotic arm. The experimental results show that the method can achieve the identification of blood vessels and the operation of their automatic injection.

articleTitle: Modelling and Control of Upper Limb Rehabilitation System Based on Variable Stiffness Joints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: With the aggravation of population aging, the incidence of stroke is increasing exponentially, the number of professional rehabilitation doctors is limited, and the application of upper limb rehabilitation robots is becoming more and more extensive. In this paper, a variable-stiffness elbow rehabilitation robot is simulated, and its dynamics are modelling and analysis, and the kinematics and dynamic performance of the robot are explored. Meanwhile, the control method of the robot is optimized to achieve adaptive position control. Finally, through the optimization and improvement of the kinematic parameters of the robot, a good rehabilitation effect is achieved. In this paper, the superior performance of variable stiffness elbow rehabilitation robot is verified by simulation, which provides an effective reference for the application of robot in elbow rehabilitation treatment.

articleTitle: Realization of Flying Capacitor Inverter Three-Level Inverter Based on DSP Code Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: At present, with the progress of electronic technology and the improvement of the demand for inverter control characteristics in various fields, multilevel inverters represented by three-level inverters have been more and more widely used. However, the algorithm of three-level inverter controlled by Space Vector Pulse Width Modulation (SVPWM) is complex, which brings great difficulty to its hardware programming. the principle of SVPWM in flying capacitor three-level inverter is described, and a control method of capacitor voltage balance which is easy to be realized digitally is proposed to solve the voltage offset problem of flying capacitor. The method inherits the widely used three-level space vector modulation strategy. By judging the unbalanced direction of the flying capacitor voltage and the flow direction of the load current, the hysteresis control is used to adjust the action mode of the redundant working state O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</inf> and O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</inf>, so as to realize the balance and stability of the flying capacitor voltage. The automatic code generation technology based on Model-Based Design (MBD) solves the problem that three-level SVPWM is difficult to be realized by hardware because of the complexity of the algorithm. The simulation results show that the proposed control scheme is correct and effective. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed control scheme is verified by simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control Design for Quadrotor Transporting System With a Cable-Suspended Rigid Payload
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In this paper, facing the aerial transportation task with a large volume cargo, the system of quadrotor with a cable-suspended rigid payload is investigated. The dynamic model of proposed system is built with Lagrange d’Alembert principle. The dynamic model is linearized to design the feedback control method. Finally, two groups of numerical simulation with proposed feedback controller are designed to demonstrate the effectiveness of system model and the results of simulation illustrate satisfactory performance.

articleTitle: Proposal of Several Swimming Methods for a Disk-shaped Underwater Robot with an Annular Pectoral Fin Propulsion Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In a conventional manta ray robot with a pectoral fin propulsion mechanism, the periodic pitch motion during swimming adversely affected the accuracy of optical flow calculations using a camera. To solve this problem, an underwater robot with an annular pectoral fin propulsion mechanism was developed, in which the shape of the robot is a disk with low fluid resistance and is surrounded by pectoral fins. In this study, we first describe how floating and sinking motions that are possible with a conventional manta ray robot can be realized using the developed underwater robot. Next, we propose a new control method for floating and sinking motions using the annular pectoral fin propulsion mechanism and a control method to reduce the pitch motion generated during forward motion by the tail fin, respectively. Finally, several in-water experiments in a swimming pool are conducted to confirm the effectiveness of the proposed methods.

articleTitle: Monocular Scene Flow Estimation with Convolution Vision Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The process of artificial intelligence processing is inseparable from the perception of information in the scene, and the monocular scene flow estimation combining the optical flow and depth can reflect the motion information in the scene. In this paper, a monocular scene flow estimation network with convolution vision transformer(CVT) is proposed. Specifically, introducing CVT into the feature extraction part of the monocular scene flow estimation network can effectively capture local information while dynamically paying attention to global context, which solves the problems of large local redundancy and complex global dependencies in computer vision data. In addition, a single rectified linear unit(RELU) activation is used in the CVT to provide pixel-wise modeling capabilities to enrich the detail feature. On the KITTI driving dataset, the experimental results show that the proposed method improves the performance of the estimation of the network and has the competitive advantage.

articleTitle: An Improved Variable Window Detection Method for Exoskeleton Assistive Timing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The exoskeleton is usually assisted by the sensor detects the moment of assist, and the assist function generates the value of the assisted force according to the time and generates the corresponding force through the motor. Among them, the determination of the exoskeleton assistance moment plays an important role in the generation of a reasonable exoskeleton curve. To this end, this paper proposes an improved method based on the variable window for determining the assistance moment of exoskeleton. The method firstly improves the way of window sliding, secondly adjusts the way of window size selection, and finally experiments confirm that the method reduces the number of operations by 29%~47% in different motion modes.

articleTitle: FEUWNet: A Fast and Effective Baseline for Underwater Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Underwater optical images are one of the important media for humans to explore the oceans, but it is difficult to directly obtain high-quality underwater images because of the unique physical and chemical properties of underwater, most underwater images exhibit disadvantages such as color decay, low contrast, and blurred details. In order to solve the above problems, this paper designed a fast and effective baseline for underwater image enhancement called FEUWNet. FEUWNet uses a plug-and-play module consists with downsampling encoding block and up-sampling decoding block to balance enhancement performance and computational speed. After experimental comparison, FEUWNet has achieved good results in underwater image enhancement.

articleTitle: DVL Modeling Using a RVM based on Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm in SINS/DVL
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: For underwater Strapdown Inertial Navigation System/Doppler Velocity Log(SINS/DVL) integrated navigation system, it is a crucial factor for the performance of integrated navigation system to estimate the scale factor of DVL and its installation relationship with SINS accurately. Firstly, the theoretical model of DVL influenced by scale factor error, installation error between SINS and DVL and dynamic attitude are established. Due to the effect of dynamic attitude angle, the velocity measurement model of DVL presents great complexity and strong nonlinearity. Hence, this paper proposes a novel DVL model training approach using relevance vector machine (RVM), in which all error sources are considered in this model without separated DVL velocity measurement models. The Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm is used to optimize the key parameters of RVM. Secondly, the constraint information from GNSS and depth sensor is applied to strengthen the accuracy and generalization of the model. Finally, the performance of this method is verified with experiment in the Yellow Sea. Compared with the traditional least square estimation method based on SVD (SVD-LS), the DVL measurement model shows higher accuracy, and the positioning error of SINS/DVL integrated navigation system has been reduced from 3.1‰ of the voyage to 1.5‰ of the voyage.

articleTitle: Improvement of Intention Estimation Method for Leader-Follower Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A leader-follower robot has the feature of remote operation so that it can be applied to a work environment that is dangerous to its operator. However, there still is a risk that the operator of this robot may make an erroneous operation due to many reasons, such as fatigue. Based on the feature of remote operation, the follower robot will faithfully perform the erroneous operation, which may be dangerous. In this research, we are aiming to develop a method that can suppress the effect of erroneous operation by estimating the operator’s correct intention and using the correct intention to operate the leader-follower robot. In this report, we list and evaluate the effect of the previous intention estimation method, then carry out a method to improve the previous intention estimation method by applying a Kalman filter.

articleTitle: Influence of the Case of the Limiting Current Oxygen Sensor on the Steady-state Temperature of the Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The working temperature of the limiting current oxygen sensor is between 400 °C and 500 °C. When the working temperature drifts, the oxygen sensor will result in inaccurate measurement and low efficiency. The reasons that affect the working temperature drift of the oxygen sensor are not only the failure of the heating electrode, but also the heat transfer of the oxygen sensor to the case. Therefore, it is very important to study the influence of the oxygen sensor case on the steady-state temperature of the sensor. In this article, finite element analysis is used to investigate the effect of the case with different materials, heights, and opening diameters on the steady-state temperature of the oxygen sensor. The results show that the difference in case material directly affects the overall heat transfer ability of the oxygen sensor, thereby affecting the working performance of the oxygen sensor. In this process, the most influential indicator is the thermal conductivity of the material; Whether it is changing the height or the diameter of the opening of the outer case, the main impact of the outer case on the steady-state temperature of the oxygen sensor is the heat transfer between solids. Fewer outer case will result in less temperature loss. In summary, by analyzing the effects of different parameters of the oxygen sensor case on its steady-state temperature, this study provides important insights into the design of optimal oxygen sensor cases. The results can be used by researchers to develop new oxygen sensor designs that can perform better in terms of accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Target Detection for X-band Marine Radar Image Based on RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Currently, X-band marine radar images are usually used to detect ships, islands and other targets on the sea. The Constant False Alarm Rate (CFAR) detection algorithm, as a classic target detection algorithm, is widely used in marine radar target detection. However, traditional CFAR detection algorithms have a long time for target detection, high false alarm rate, and are difficult to detect targets in sea clutter background. In response to the above issues, this article proposes a fast detection algorithm for maritime radar targets based on a combination of radial basis function (RBF) neural network and CFAR. This algorithm can improve the efficiency and accuracy of target detection in sea clutter background, so that ships can quickly and accurately discover targets in the marine military battlefield to obtain battlefield initiative. At the same time, it can ensure rapid and accurate detection of targets under extreme conditions of high waves, effectively avoiding ship collisions with rocks, and ensuring safe navigation. This algorithm first obtains an RBF neural network model and uses it for coarse target detection. Then, under the assumption that the sea clutter follows a Gaussian distribution, CFAR is used for precise target detection of potential target data. Improve the efficiency and accuracy of target detection by combining coarse detection and fine detection. In addition, to ensure the accuracy of target detection, it is necessary to preprocess the image. This article uses a mean filtering method to denoise the original radar image. The experimental results in this paper show that the method is feasible and can effectively detect targets from X-band marine radar images.

articleTitle: A 2D-Laser-based Pedestrian Detector for Mobile Robots via Self-Supervised Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The applications of mobile robots have gradually expanded to complex environments in human daily life. These environments often involve pedestrian activities that possess diverse purposes and statuses. Consequently, it becomes necessary to introduce pedestrian detection models that can predict the exact locations of pedestrians. However, the efficacy of 2D-Laser-based pedestrian detection models trained on open-source datasets is hindered by the difficulty of deploying them on mobile robots. The laser point cloud data from the mobile robot differs in device and resolution. Therefore, it’s non-trivial to deploy a pedestrian detection model trained on open-source datasets to a physical robot. To tackle this problem, we propose a pedestrian detection framework based on self-supervision. The framework is comprised of a pre-trained laser-based detector and a self-supervised data annotator. Our proposed method allows for rapid transfer learning by aligning the laser and camera. The data annotator employs instance segmentation on camera images to generate pseudo-labels for laser point clouds. These pseudo-labels are then used to bridge the gap between open-source data and laser point cloud data collected from mobile robots through transfer learning. Extensive experiments and visualizations reveal the efficacy of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Control system design of heterogeneous master-slave robot for fracture reduction surgery of long bone
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In this paper, a control system of master-slave robot is designed for fracture reduction surgery of long bone. The master operator and the slave reduction robot belong to different parallel structures which means the pose mapping can only be performed in Cartesian space. A kind of absolute mapping algorithm is proposed obeying master-slave pose consistency principle. Then joint trajectory of the slave robot is planned based on master-slave pose errors. The trajectory is polynomially interpolated by desired position and velocity of each joint. Software for master-slave surgical robot is designed for better interaction in the surgery. Finally the master-slave pose following experiment under no-load condition is conducted. Experimental results show that the control system designed for surgical robot can meet the following requirement of fracture reduction surgery.

articleTitle: Sonar Electronic Platform System Design
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: As an important component of underwater positioning systems, the performance of acoustic beacons cannot be ignored as it directly impacts the overall system performance. The demand for reliability, stability, compatibility, and various functionalities of acoustic beacons is urgent. With the rapid development of ocean engineering and the increasing requirements for underwater positioning systems, it is imperative to design highly versatile, stable, and reliable acoustic beacons. Therefore, this paper proposes an acoustic electronic platform system that can reliably control underwater beacon sound emission.

articleTitle: Study on The Limit Size Determination Method of The Inlet Hole of The Limiting Current Oxygen Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: When the oxygen reaction rate of the limiting current oxygen sensor is smaller than the oxygen diffusion capacity of the diffusion hole, the current drift occurs. Therefore, it is important to determine the size of the diffusion hole of the limiting current oxygen sensor. In this paper, the minimum and maximum sizes of the diffusion hole are calculated successively by substituting the parameters of the limiting current oxygen sensor, and the limiting size of the inlet hole of the limiting current oxygen sensor is derived. The results show that in order to ensure the oxygen diffusion processing free diffusion state of the limiting current oxygen sensor, it is necessary to limit the minimum opening diameter of the inlet hole to 2.5$\mu$m. The stability condition of the oxygen transfer capability of the limiting current oxygen sensor is proposed, and the maximum values of the radii of the inlet and outlet holes of the diffusion hole are 159$\mu$m and 63$\mu$m, respectively.

articleTitle: Design of MADDPG Capture Algorithm for Multiple UAV Cooperation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Based on the background of Multiple Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (Multi-UAV) game with limited attack and defense capabilities and communication range, a game model is established to study the capture and attack problem of a red UAV team against its blue target UAV in this paper. Under the Actor-Critic framework of multi-agent deep deterministic policy gradient (MADDPG) algorithm, the original MADDPG algorithm is improved according to the characteristics of the game scenario to solve the problem of UAVs’ number attenuation and sparse rewards. The simulation results shows that the algorithm designed in this paper has improved the convergence speed, learning efficiency and stability. The sub-networks make the algorithm more suitable for the game scenario where the number of UAVs is dynamically declining.

articleTitle: Classification of EEG signals based on CNN-Transformer model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Brain-computer interfaces (BCI) based on EEG have attracted extensive research and attention worldwide, while motor imagery (MI), mental arithmetic (MA), and P300 event-related potentials are a few of the more commonly used paradigms.Vision Transformer(ViT) is a new Transformer model that has superior global processing power compared to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN).In this study, we propose a hybrid CNN-Transformer based model that uses CNN to convolve EEG signals in time and space, followed by ViT for global processing, and finally optimizes the model using 10-run $\times 10$-fold cross-validation and validates it on a publicly available dataset of 29 subjects. Final accuracies of 87.23% and 90.79% were achieved on the MI and MA tasks, respectively. Compared to other literature, the model achieved higher classification accuracies.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity Allocation of Hybrid Energy Storage System for Offshore Wind Power Platform Based on Improved Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Reducing the magnitude of wind power grid fluctuations to ensure the stability of the power system has been a research hotspot in the development of offshore wind platforms. How to optimize the capacity of hybrid energy storage system while achieving the task of power output smoothing is also an important issue in this field. This paper proposes a method to optimize the configuration of hybrid energy storage system capacity for offshore wind power platform using improved particle swarm algorithm, with the goal of minimizing investment costs. The stable and safe operation of the offshore wind power system is ensured on the basis of comprehensive consideration of its operational state design constraints. Additionally, the optimization results and iteration curves of the improved particle swarm algorithm and the standard particle swarm algorithm are also presented in this paper to verify the improvement effect on the standard particle swarm algorithm.

articleTitle: Observer-based Saturated Control for Dynamic Positioning Ship with Mismatched Disturbance and Input MRS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In this article, an observer-based dynamic surface saturated control law is adopt for dynamic positioning(DP) ships subject to input magnitude and rate saturation(MRS), mismatched disturbance and unknown disturbance. The mismatched disturbance caused by the model transformation or measurement uncertainties is analyzed and two disturbance observers are introduced while the steady performance is improved. By using dynamic surface control technique, an observer-based control strategy is developed without solving partial differential equations. In addition, integrated augment MRS model and auxiliary system, the effect caused by input MRS is handled while the better transient performance is achieved. Then, the stability of the closed-loop system is proven via Lyapunov technique. Finally, simulations demonstrate the advantageous and effectiveness of the method in this paper comparing with previous works.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of A Linear Piezoelectric Actuator Based on The Bridge Displacement Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: To meet the demands of small, high-precision attitude adjustment systems in space environments, a novel linear piezoelectric actuator was developed. This design drew inspiration from the locomotion mechanism observed in insect larvae, harnessing the advantageous features of piezoelectric actuators, such as their wide temperature tolerance, immunity to electromagnetic interference, and power-off self-locking capabilities. The actuator consists of multiple piezoelectric ceramic stacks divided into three groups, which serve as the driving source of the actuator and the clamping unit, respectively, with output displacement amplified by a bridge-type displacement amplifier. The working principle and driving process of the actuator are elaborated in detail, and a static model is established for the displacement amplifier. A theoretical model is proposed for the calculation of the amplification ratio, and finite element analysis is conducted on the input stiffness and amplification ratio of the amplification mechanism. The analysis results show that at an excitation voltage of 75 V, the collaborative amplification ratio of the piezoelectric ceramic stack and the displacement amplifier is 4.4, and the maximum step size of the actuator is 99.7 μm. When the excitation voltage is 75 V and the output force is 100 N, the step length of the actuator is 35.1 μm. This actuator can be used in small, high-precision attitude adjustment systems in space environments.

articleTitle: Online Monitoring of Reciprocating Compressor Health Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Due to the non-linear and non-smooth characteristics of reciprocating compressor vibration signals and the influence of environmental noise, the current online feature extraction methods are not suitable for direct fault diagnosis of reciprocating compressors. Hence, there is an urgent need to find out the characteristic parameters with low noise sensitivity for reciprocating compressor fault monitoring. In this paper, multi-scale fuzzy entropy is used to analyze the vibration signal at the main shaft of the reciprocating compressor motor, and the multi-scale fuzzy entropy is standardized to determine the operating status according to its change range. The field application of the compressor enables timely detection of wear faults at the main bearing of the motor, which is more stable and efficient than the traditional feature extraction method and can detect early faults.

articleTitle: Improved Design and Research of a New Type of Bubble Separation Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: With the improvement of living standards, the development of human industry has brought a lot of problems to the environment, especially soil and water pollution. Therefore, rapid detection of harmful substances is of great significance. At present, flow injection method is commonly used in the world, which can be used for rapid and accurate detection of water quality. One of the more important links is the separation of gas and liquid. Based on the existing gas-liquid separation devices on the market, this paper optimizes the design of a high-efficiency gas-liquid separation device for flow injection, which can quickly peel the gas from the liquid in the detection process. Through the analysis of the gas-liquid flow path, the separation mode and mechanism are studied, and the simulation of the gas-liquid separator and the real experiment test have achieved the ideal effect, thus verifying the feasibility of its optimal design. This paper describes the gas-liquid separation device including mechanical design, flow path analysis, simulation and experimental verification.

articleTitle: Faster Implementation of the Dynamic Window Approach via Polar Coordinate Transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The dynamic window approach (DWA) is a collision avoidance strategy for mobile robots, optimized to guide a robot to its target while maintaining a safe distance from any visible obstacle in the vicinity. Although DWA has undergone several improvements and applications, its primary computational process has remained mostly unchanged, thereby resulting in a high level of complexity. Drawing inspiration from the velocity invariance assumption of DWA and polar coordinate transformations in the model, we propose a high-speed version of DWA.

articleTitle: A Novel 3D Point Clouds Registration Method Without Data Association
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: 3D point cloud registration is an essential task for localization and mapping technology, in which a correct data association is necessary for point cloud registration algorithms. However, the data association is time-consuming and prone to mismatching, which degrades the efficiency and accuracy of point cloud registration. In this paper, to solve this problem, a direct 3D point cloud registration method without data association is proposed, in which the relative pose is achieved through extracting and aligning the principal directions of two point-cloud sets. The point clouds are projected into the three principal directions and the variances of projected points are compared to obtain the unique solution.
